Hello, %PLAYERNAME%! Can you believe we’re already approaching the year’s end?
But what a year it’s been! Rife with surprises, discoveries—and so many Pokémon!
In fact, I think I saw some familiar Pokémon while I was out walking earlier. Perhaps they’ve gathered to celebrate with us.
Why don’t you get out there and try to catch a few?
We’ve certainly crossed paths with some fascinating Pokémon this past year, haven’t we, %PLAYERNAME%?
I’ll never forget the moment I finally witnessed Kecleon’s masterful camouflage firsthand.
And how about when we encountered all those Pokémon first discovered in the Paldea region?
Watching those Bombirdier soaring overhead was a thrill and a half!
Which Pokémon were you most excited to encounter this year, %PLAYERNAME%?
Who knows—the best may still be yet to come!
I was just reminiscing about all the ways we’ve connected with fellow Trainers this past year.
From showcasing our favorite Pokémon to partying up with friends and taking on challenges together, it feels like our community has never been more connected.
Do you ever stop while exploring a Route to think about all the other Trainers who’ve walked that same path? All the incredible adventures they’ve had and the ones they have ahead?
As we explore today, let’s appreciate the wonderful community we’re part of and the friends we’ve made this year. Let’s GO!
You should be incredibly proud of what you’ve achieved this year. I know I am!
And yet, something tells me you’re only getting started.
Wherever our journey takes us next, I’m grateful to be by your side.
But enough about the future. Let’s get back out there and enjoy the present!
Is it just me, or are our surroundings looking...fluffier than usual today? It must be all these Mareep around!
Mareep might look tantalizingly soft, but a word of warning before you go in for a hug—static electricity builds up in their fluffy coat, so touching one will give you quite a shock!
In lieu of a Mareep cuddle, how about a Mareep huddle? Let’s put our heads together and see what we can learn about this wonderful Pokémon!
Let’s take a closer look at the Mareep you just caught.
Did you know that it stores air in its wool coat, allowing it to stay cool when it’s hot and warm when it’s cold?
In the warm months, its fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.
Then, when cool weather blows in and brings dry air with it, Mareep’s wool doubles in size and the tip of its tail glows slightly.
Say, why don’t you help a few Mareep evolve so we can learn more about Flaaffy, too?
Well done, %PLAYERNAME%! Those are some happy-looking Pokémon.
Flaaffy’s fluffy fleece can store lots of electricity.
So much, in fact, that it has developed patches of rubbery skin that don’t conduct electricity. This helps protect Flaaffy from being electrocuted.
Like Mareep, Flaaffy’s tail is a great indicator of how much electric charge it has stored. When its coat is fully charged, its tail lights up.
Flaffy’s Evolution, Ampharos, also has an impressive tail...but let’s not get ahead of ourselves!
I’ll tell you more about that after you’ve helped Flaaffy evolve.
Wool-hoo, %PLAYERNAME%! That is one dazzling Ampharos!
Did you know the tip of Ampharos’s tail shines so brightly that it can be seen from space? That’s no tall tale! Haha!
This Pokémon’s light has been treasured by people since ancient times. It acts as a beacon for the lost—and in the olden days, people used it to send signals back and forth across great distances.
It’s no wonder Ampharos is known as the Light Pokémon!
I just know it’ll shine bright in all your wonderful adventures together, %PLAYERNAME%.
Thanks for spending the day learning with me. I’ll see you next time!
I wanted to warn you about the feathers you may have seen scattered around. If you’re considering picking one up—don’t. They’re surprisingly sharp. Trust me.
I have a hypothesis about the identity of our feather flinger, but I’d love an extra set of eyes to confirm it. Could you poke around and let me know what you find?
Aha! I was right! These feathers belong to Rowlet, the Grass Quill Pokémon.
As a Grass type, Rowlet use photosynthesis to store up energy during the day.
Rowlet are typically active at night—thus my initial hesitancy to pin this loose plumage on them.
Though delightfully round and known to cuddle up in Trainers’ backpacks, this Pokémon shouldn’t be underestimated. Rowlet has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers.
Certainly not a Pokémon whose feathers you want to ruffle.
Consider my interest piqued! How about we see what we can learn about its Evolution next?
Just look at that dashing Dartrix, %PLAYERNAME%!
Dartrix is known to be a bit of a dandy. It never slacks when it comes to cleaning its feathers.
Thorough preening keeps it looking spiffy and its knife-like feathers—appropriately dubbed “blade quills”—nice and sharp.
It throws these quills at its enemies, striking their weak points with remarkable precision.
Let’s go ahead and give evolving Dartrix a shot.
Decidueye is an expert archer. It can nock and fire an arrow quill in a tenth of a second and pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.
Despite its cool demeanor, when caught by surprise, it’s seized by panic.
That happens to me from time to time!
A colleague recently told me that Decidueye’s appearance may be influenced by its environment. Isn’t that fascinating?
Anyway, thanks for indulging my curiosity today, %PLAYERNAME%. It’s always such a delight to research on the fly with you. Until next time!

Well, hey there! I’m Mateo. You must be %PLAYERNAME%. Professor Willow has told me a lot about you, so it’s grand to finally put a face to the name.
I hear you’ve been a great help with his research. That’s actually how he and I met—out in the field!
I come from a long line of researchers and love observing Pokémon in different habitats.
My travels take me all around the world, and I enjoy picking up Gifts from the places I’ve been—as well as sharing those Gifts with the Trainers I meet.
Whenever you hear adventure calling, find me on a Route and I’ll show you what I mean!
Good to see you, %PLAYERNAME%! So you’ve had the chance to check out a Route, eh?
I find it invigorating to follow in the figurative footsteps of our fellow explorers and see the world through their eyes.
It’s also a great way to pick up Gifts to share with other Trainers!
And speaking of Routes, I see you’ve met my good friend Mateo! We go way back. He’s a gold-star guy, and I hope you get to know him as well as I do.
By the way, did you see the tape measure Mateo keeps wrapped around his hat?
He keeps it handy to better survey the land he travels and to measure the Pokémon he encounters—especially if they’re small. But I’ll let him tell you more about that.
Now, in the spirit of Mateo, why don’t you get out there and explore some more Routes yourself?
Well, if it isn’t my new friend %PLAYERNAME%! I enjoyed running into you on my last outing!
You taking care of yourself? Me, I always make sure to drink plenty of water when I’m out on a Route. Hydrate or...well, hydrate, I always say!
I’ve started doing lunges between Routes, too. Talk about taking a big step forward!
Get it? “A big step”? Gahaha! My little sister taught me that joke. Speaking of, I can’t wait to show her all the amazing Postcards I’ve collected, like the one I got over in—
Oops! There I go again. I just have so many stories to tell! And I’m sure you will too if you keep following Routes.
Now, I oughta get going, but I’m sure our paths will cross again soon. See you on the road, %PLAYERNAME%!
%PLAYERNAME%! Seems like you and Mateo have become fast friends. I’m thrilled you two have hit it off!
It’s clear that your dedication to exchanging Gifts has made an impression on him.
He even left some items for me to pass along before he set off on his next adventure!
Please give Mateo my regards when you see him.
And remember—as you explore Routes and exchange Gifts, you’re bridging the gap between Trainers around the world!
Do you feel the change in the air? The seasons are shifting, and nature is transforming right before our eyes. Isn’t it inspiring?
The change in seasons often brings different Pokémon to the places around us.
And you know what that means—it’s a great  time to head out and see what Pokémon we encounter!
Looks like you found a variety of Pokémon, %PLAYERNAME%!
Do you feel the call to adventure with any of them?
Spending time with a buddy is a great way to strengthen your bond!
You and your buddy make a terrific team.
It’s important to tend to our friendships—both with Pokémon and people.
Why not send a few Gifts to your friends to show them how much you care?
I’m sure your fellow Trainers appreciated all the Gifts.
Now, while you were out exploring, some colleagues of mine entrusted me with a couple of intriguing items for us to research.
In fact, I’ve never seen anything quite like them!
I need time to prepare, but I’ll let you know when we can start researching in earnest.
Hey, %PLAYERNAME%! Come take a look at these items my colleagues asked me to research.
They’re called the “Adamant Crystal” and the “Lustrous Globe”—treasures from the Sinnoh region that date back to when it was called the Hisui region.
With names like those, they’re bound to lead to exciting discoveries! Will you join me in learning more about them? I’ll do my own digging while you’re out in the field.
Greetings, %PLAYERNAME%. It has been some time since we last spoke. I hope you have been well.
Professor Willow has asked me to help with his ongoing research on the Adamant Crystal and Lustrous Globe.
Unfortunately, I haven’t come across anything like them in my travels.
Perhaps together, we can learn more about these items and the secrets they may hold.
I suggest we start by learning more about the Pokémon around us to see if that triggers any insights.
I did some independent research while you were in the field.
While I have not uncovered any true leads, I can at least confirm that the Adamant Crystal and Lustrous Globe are not related to the Ultra Beasts.
It may feel as if we have reached a dead end, but I am confident that with diligent research, we will learn more soon.
For now, let us continue to observe Pokémon so that we may share our findings with Professor Willow upon his return.
Here I am, %PLAYERNAME%! You know, it’s great seeing you and Rhi back in action as a team.
Oh... You hit a dead end, huh? Hey, no sweat—that’s often the case with Pokémon research!
Thankfully, I was able to find a few hints in some old manuscripts sent to me by colleagues in the Sinnoh region.
They mentioned that the Adamant Crystal and Lustrous Globe are somehow connected to Dialga and Palkia—Legendary Pokémon originally discovered in the very same Sinnoh region!
I’m gobsmacked by this discovery and can’t wait to learn more.
Come back in a little while, won’t you, %PLAYERNAME%? Once I’ve collated my data, I’ll have more research opportunities for you!
